issues: The PDF export endpoint (/export/pdf) generates a PDF that only lists individual receipts and mileage entries but does not include the required tax‑ready summary (income, expenses, mileage deduction, estimated tax). According to the specification, the PDF should be tax‑ready, i.e., contain those summary numbers so the user can file taxes directly from the exported document. Update the PDF generation logic to prepend (or otherwise include) a summary section with the dashboard totals before the detailed receipt/mileage listings.

Optionally, the CSV export currently only contains raw receipt and mileage rows without any summary of totals. While not strictly validated by the acceptance tests, a tax‑ready CSV generally includes a summary row or separate section for income, expenses, mileage deduction, and estimated tax. Consider adding a summary row (or additional rows) after the data rows to provide these totals.
feedback: All acceptance tests pass and static checks are clean, but the PDF export does not meet the "tax‑ready" requirement as it lacks the summary section requested in the task description. Adding the summary will align the implementation with the original specifications.
